newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SMALL, TEICHMANN ON ROAD TO RECOVERY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SMALL, TEICHMANN ON ROAD TO RECOVERY.

text.p: Springbok skipper Gary Teichmann and leading try-scorer James Small should be fit to face the British Lions in the first test on June 21.
The pair limped out of Tuesday's 74-10 victory over Tonga with what appeared to be serious hamstring injuries.
Neither number eight Teichmann nor wing Small -- who is South Africa's leading post-isolation try-scorer with 15 touchdowns -- are expected to train before Monday.
But coach Carel du Plessis said on Wednesday: "Both are recovering well and I am confident that they will be able to take a full part on Monday."
Lock Fritz van Heerden, who injured a hip, has already been cleared to play.
Du Plessis will announce his team to meet the Lions in the first game of the three-test series on Saturday.
